subject.title: [Feature]: Stop Burying Your Agent's Soul: Configurable Context File Elevation

question: Should bootstrap file elevation be accepted as a typed core config surface, exposed through plugin/context-engine hooks, or rejected in favor of current Project Context plus SOUL/MEMORY guidance?
rationale: The requested behavior adds prompt-architecture and configuration surface in an area where repository policy requires maintainer intent before adding core config or one-off prompt rules.

options.title: Plugin/context-engine surface
options.body: Expose or document a narrow extension path so an external implementation can map bootstrap files to prompt additions without hardcoding new core config.

options.title: Typed core config
options.body: Add a schema-documented config option for deterministic section mapping and exclusion, with tests and docs for fresh and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Keep the current flat Project Context renderer with SOUL/MEMORY guidance and close or redirect elevation requests as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Plugin/context-engine surface
recommendation.body: Expose or document a narrow extension path so an external implementation can map bootstrap files to prompt additions without hardcoding new core config.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter supplied the latest maintainer-side review framing and has recent adjacent commits in the system-prompt/API surface.
